_comment: run_25 = run_23a + IDEAL-FREE SETTLEMENT (settlement.form = ideal_free, block 3 cells ~ 81 km): after dispersal each year, each block's population (adults, juvenile stayers, juvenile arrivers separately) is redistributed in proportion to capacity K; mass conserved exactly, no new parameters; the block grid shifts by one cell on alternate years.

Tests H1/H2 (research/age_model): if arrivals settle where capacity is locally highest, cells fill and clear mate-finding without lambda0 ~ 2 or a strong Allee effect. User idea (C11): multi-step dispersal with 'oracle' settlement.
